## Why

_Problem, motivation, and what was wrong or missing before this change._

## What users see

_User-visible outcome in plain language. Before/after if helpful. If not user-facing, say **Not user-facing** and name the subsystem._

## How we did it

_Summary of the technical approach. Key decisions, notable refactors, flags or migrations._

**In scope:** _…_

**Out of scope / follow-ups:** _None / …_

## Context

_Links: Jira, Confluence, Figma, incidents, related PRs. **None** if not applicable._

## Verification

_How this was validated (tests, deploy to test, etc.). **Include concrete paths to interact with the change:** routes or URLs, test/staging environment, feature flags, roles, and step-by-step what to open or click. Note any behavioral changes someone re-testing should expect._

---

## Completion checklist

- [ ] **Why** — problem and motivation are filled in
- [ ] **What users see** — user-visible outcome is filled in, or **Not user-facing** + subsystem is stated
- [ ] **How we did it** — approach is filled in; **In scope** and **Out of scope** are filled in
- [ ] **Context** — Jira, Confluence, or other links are included, or **None** is explicit
- [ ] **Verification** — validation is described, including **paths or steps to exercise the change** (and test env / deploy target if you used one)
